### CVE-2020-7062 — Null Pointer Dereference in PHP Session Upload Progress
- Assigner: php | Published: 2020-02-27 | Updated: 2024-09-16 | Max CVSS: 7.5
- CWE: CWE-476 CWE-476 NULL Pointer Dereference
- CVSS 3.1 (cna): 7.5 HIGH `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:N/I:N/A:H`

In PHP versions 7.2.x below 7.2.28, 7.3.x below 7.3.15 and 7.4.x below 7.4.3, when using file upload functionality, if upload progress tracking is enabled, but session.upload_progress.cleanup is set to 0 (disabled), and the file upload fails, the upload procedure would try to clean up data that does not exist and encounter null pointer dereference, which would likely lead to a crash.

**workarounds:** Disable file uploading, file upload tracking or enable session.upload_progress.cleanup.

Affected:
- PHP Group / PHP: affected 7.3.x <7.3.15 (custom); affected 7.4.x <7.4.3 (custom); affected 7.2.x <7.2.28 (custom)

Credits: Reported by ryat@php.net

References:
- https://bugs.php.net/bug.php?id=79221 [x_refsource_MISC]
- http://lists.opensuse.org/opensuse-security-announce/2020-03/msg00023.html [vendor-advisory,x_refsource_SUSE]
- https://security.gentoo.org/glsa/202003-57 [vendor-advisory,x_refsource_GENTOO]
- https://lists.debian.org/debian-lts-announce/2020/03/msg00034.html [mailing-list,x_refsource_MLIST]
- https://usn.ubuntu.com/4330-1/ [vendor-advisory,x_refsource_UBUNTU]
- https://www.debian.org/security/2020/dsa-4717 [vendor-advisory,x_refsource_DEBIAN]
- https://www.debian.org/security/2020/dsa-4719 [vendor-advisory,x_refsource_DEBIAN]
- https://www.tenable.com/security/tns-2021-14 [x_refsource_CONFIRM]

### CVE-2020-7065 — mb_strtolower (UTF-32LE): stack-buffer-overflow at php_unicode_tolower_full
- Assigner: php | Published: 2020-04-01 | Updated: 2024-09-17 | Max CVSS: 7.4
- CWE: CWE-121 CWE-121 Stack-based Buffer Overflow
- CVSS 3.1 (cna): 7.4 HIGH `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:H/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:N/I:H/A:H`

In PHP versions 7.3.x below 7.3.16 and 7.4.x below 7.4.4, while using mb_strtolower() function with UTF-32LE encoding, certain invalid strings could cause PHP to overwrite stack-allocated buffer. This could lead to memory corruption, crashes and potentially code execution.

Affected:
- PHP Group / PHP: affected 7.3.x <7.3.16 (custom); affected 7.4.x <7.4.4 (custom)

Credits: anatoly dot trosinenko at gmail dot com

References:

### CVE-2020-7067 — OOB Read in urldecode()
- Assigner: php | Published: 2020-04-27 | Updated: 2024-09-17 | Max CVSS: 7.5
- CWE: CWE-125 CWE-125 Out-of-bounds Read; CWE-196 CWE-196 Unsigned to Signed Conversion Error
- CVSS 3.1 (cna): 7.5 HIGH `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:N/A:N`

In PHP versions 7.2.x below 7.2.30, 7.3.x below 7.3.17 and 7.4.x below 7.4.5, if PHP is compiled with EBCDIC support (uncommon), urldecode() function can be made to access locations past the allocated memory, due to erroneously using signed numbers as array indexes.

Affected:
- PHP Group / PHP: affected 7.2.x below 7.2.30; affected 7.3.x below 7.3.17 and 7.4.x below 7.4.5

Credits: bigshaq at wearehackerone dot com
